address: 2469/7 New Phetchaburi Road, Bang Kapi, Huai Khwang, Bangkok, 10310, Thailand
bio: This restaurant hidden among buildings on New Phetchaburi Road has a calm interior done out with timber, white walls and floaty curtains – it feels like a friend's home. Mildly spiced recipes from the owner's family in Phrae Province are well balanced, kid friendly and include vegetarian options. Go for the rice noodles in clear soup with pungent fingerroot and spices, pork broth and a crunchy and spicy herb dip. Good for solo diners or a quick meal.
